import hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'tools'))
import fingerprint, image, inplace, catalogue_local_entries as local
sha = lambda value: hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
proof_path = root / 'research/catalogue_v13_section_proof.json'
proof = json.loads(proof_path.read_text())
expected = next(s for s in proof['sections'] if s['id'] == '00191c80:1:cxa_guard_acquire.o')
witness = expected['witness']
archive_path = root / witness['archive']
archive_digest = sha(archive_path.read_bytes())
assert archive_digest == witness['archive_sha256']
selected = next(member for member in fingerprint.archive_members(archive_path) if member.offset == witness['member_offset'])
assert selected.name == witness['member']
member_digest = sha(selected.data)
assert member_digest == witness['member_sha256']
obj = inplace.ObjectFile(Path(selected.name), data=selected.data)
section = obj.sections[expected['index']]
properties = {'name': section.name, 'size': section.size, 'alignment': section.align, 'executable': section.executable, 'writable': section.writable, 'nobits': section.nobits}
assert properties == {key: expected[key] for key in properties}
assert [list(row) for row in section.mapping] == expected['mapping']
symbols = [{'name': row.name, 'kind': row.kind, 'bind': row.bind, 'value': row.value, 'offset': inplace._symbol_offset(row), 'size': row.size} for row in obj.symbols if row.shndx == expected['index'] and row.name not in ('$a', '$t', '$d')]
assert symbols == expected['symbols']
assert not section.relocs and not expected['relocations']
original = image.Image.load()
original_part = original.read(expected['base'], section.size)
section_digest = sha(section.data)
assert section_digest == expected['object_sha256'] == expected['image_sha256']
assert section.data == original_part
catalogue_path = root / 'config/catalogue.json'
catalogue = json.loads(catalogue_path.read_text())
function = next(row for row in catalogue['functions'] if row['address'] == expected['base'])
assert function['size'] == section.size and function['isa'] == 'thumb' and function['kind'] == 'function'
assert local.metadata_sha(function) == expected['bindings'][0]['record_sha256']
names_path = root / 'config/names.json'
names = json.loads(names_path.read_text())
assert names['symbols']['__cxa_guard_acquire']['address'] == expected['base']
caller_path = root / 'scratch/authors/fa12/match/context-func_00180234/attempt-01/func_00180234.o'
caller = inplace.ObjectFile(caller_path)
guard_relocs = [{'section': s.name, 'offset': r.offset, 'type': r.type, 'symbol': r.symbol.name, 'symbol_kind': r.symbol.kind, 'symbol_section': r.symbol.shndx} for s in caller.sections.values() for r in s.relocs if r.symbol.name == '__cxa_guard_acquire']
assert guard_relocs
caller_receipt_path = root / 'scratch/authors/fa12/match/context-func_00180234/attempt-01/func_00180234.result.json'
caller_receipt = json.loads(caller_receipt_path.read_text())
assert all(r['status'] == 'match' for r in caller_receipt['functions'])
result = {'method': 'Reopened the exact retained archive/member and compared its full relocation-free allocated section to the current original owner; recompiled the natural C++ function-local-static caller and inspected its real __cxa_guard_acquire relocation.', 'function': 'func_00191c80', 'address': '0x00191c80', 'size': section.size, 'isa': 'thumb', 'catalogue_kind': function['kind'], 'research/catalogue_v13_section_proof.json', 'section_proof_sha256': sha(proof_path.read_bytes()), 'section_id': expected['id'], 'archive': witness['archive'], 'archive_sha256': archive_digest,
